location: 101 Heights Blvd., Washington Avenue Corridor, Houston, TX
status: plans to have its last day of service on July 19
short_description: Killen's Southern comfort food restaurant announced its last day of service will be July 19, with a "Farewell Menu" launching June 30 featuring original menu items. The property is being sold and converted into a gas station.

location: East Kilbride Shopping Centre, East Kilbride, South Lanarkshire, Scotland (UK)
short_description: Superdrug opened a new 5,500 sq ft branch inside the East Kilbride Shopping Centre in Scotland, relocating to a larger empty unit to enhance the shopping experience.

location: Fountain Shoppes at Park City Center, Lancaster County, PA
status: grand opening being held on Monday, July 13
short_description: McAlister's Deli is opening a new location in the Fountain Shoppes at the Park City Center in Lancaster County, with a grand opening set for July 13 at 10 a.m. The first 100 guests will be eligible for a free tea for the year giveaway.

status: will debut around December, pending approvals
short_description: Yumee Katsu is planning a new location at 654 E 1st St in Tustin, CA, taking over the former Pineapple Hill Grill space, according to a plan review filing with the Orange County Health Care Agency. The franchisee estimates a December debut pending health and county approvals.

location: CherryVale Mall (center court), Cherry Valley, IL
short_description: Sassy Mac Boys, a gourmet macaroni and cheese restaurant originally founded as a food truck, cut the ribbon on its second brick-and-mortar location at CherryVale Mall in Cherry Valley on June 27. The 300-square-foot space fills the former Wetzel's Pretzels location in center court.

status: preparing to expand; opening date not yet announced
short_description: Rebol, a fast-casual bowl concept operated by Ethos Hospitality Group, is planning to open a new location at the former Hot Chicken Takeover space at 935 Polaris Pkwy. in Westerville. No opening date has been announced.

location: 5534 Randolph Road, Rockville, MD (Montrose Shopping Center)
short_description: K-Wave opened its first Maryland location at the Montrose Shopping Center in Rockville on Saturday, drawing large crowds and long lines. The nearly 3,000-square-foot store features K-Pop merchandise, K-beauty products, stationery, claw machines, and more.

location: 4700 Hampden Lane (lower level, Hampden House), Bethesda, MD
status: will officially open for dinner service on Monday, June 29
short_description: The Food Market, Chef Chad Gauss's restaurant concept known for elevated comfort food, is opening its Bethesda location at the Hampden House development on June 29. This marks the concept's third location, following Baltimore (2012) and Columbia (2024).

Dolly Parton celebrated the grand opening of Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop, located just off I-65 south of Nashville in Cornersville, featuring themed merchandise, a full-service restaurant, and live music. Parton attended the ribbon-cutting ceremony herself.

location: Near Highway 77 and Grove Creek Road, Waxahachie, TX
short_description: A new 160,000 sq ft Sam's Club warehouse is coming to Waxahachie, Texas. The exact opening date has not been announced. Texas is home to more Sam's Club locations than any other state.

Colorado-based chicken sandwich chain Birdcall announced plans to open nearly 100 locations across six Midwest states by 2031. Indiana is an initial focus, with 10–15 restaurants planned statewide and 2–3 in Fort Wayne. Birdcall currently operates 17 restaurants in Colorado, Arizona, and Texas.
Lina's Trattoria, an Italian restaurant that opened in August 2024, announced its closure. Ownership of the space has transferred to another Calgary Italian restaurant, Scarpetta Cucina.

Pixie's Candy Parlour closed its location at The District in Calgary's northeast after a decade, citing unaffordable rent. The brand is not disappearing but faced hurdles in relocating to its warehouse's front space.
Calgary's first hand-pulled noodle restaurant, Calan Beef Noodle's downtown location, was listed among closures coming soon. No additional details were available from the truncated article text.

Dadeville resident Rachel Mowery is opening Firefly Pages, set to become the city's only bookstore, on July 11 with hours from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. The store will carry new releases, local author books, and various genres, along with a trade program and book-themed merchandise. Author Sabreena Rogers will attend the grand opening to sign copies of her newest release.

location: Fort Andross Mill building, Brunswick, ME
short_description: Jeremy and Marina Kratzer have opened Paolo's, a new Italian restaurant in the former Frontier/Nomad space in the Fort Andross Mill building in Brunswick. The menu features New Jersey-style Italian American cuisine with wood-fired pizza and other dishes, and is open Thursday through Sunday 5–9 p.m.

status: shutting the majority of its Saks Off 5th outlets
short_description: Saks and Neiman Marcus parent company exited Chapter 11 bankruptcy and rebranded as Exemplar Luxury Group, shutting most Saks Off 5th discount outlets as part of its restructuring. The company cut its debt by nearly 75% and secured $500 million in new financing.

location: Deer Crest, Deer Valley East Village, UT
short_description: Canopy by Hilton Deer Valley, the first Utah location of the Canopy brand, is scheduled to open at the end of July as the third hotel in Deer Valley East Village. The four-story, 180-room property features four dining venues, an indoor pool, and skier services, and is owned by Extell Development Company.

location: Santana Row, Park Valencia, San Jose, CA
short_description: Johnny Doughnuts, an artisanal doughnut bakery originally from Marin County, hosted a grand opening party at its new Santana Row location on June 27. The bakery, founded in 2012, is known for elevated classic doughnuts and has been rated among the Top 5 Doughnuts in America by the Food Network.

The original 1UP Arcade in LoDo, Denver, played its last game on June 22 after 15 years in operation since 2011. Other 1UP locations in the Denver metro area remain open, and a new location is planned for Belmar.

Church & Union, a Southern-style eatery from Top Chef alum Jaime Lynch, took its curtain call in LoDo this week. The restaurant had worked closely with the Denver Center for Performing Arts to craft themed pre-theater dinner experiences.
Kinoya Sushi and Izakaya is now open on Dry Creek Road in Centennial, listed among Denver-area openings this week. No further details were provided in the article.

The Giant Company opened a new supermarket at the Andorra Shopping Center, drawing hundreds of shoppers to a ribbon-cutting ceremony. Philadelphia's Deputy Commerce Director attended, and Giant gave reusable bags filled with groceries and samples to the first 200 customers.

Dolly Parton's Tennessean Travel Stop officially opened on June 24 in Cornersville, Tennessee, with a ribbon-cutting by Dolly herself. The travel stop features gas pumps, EV charging stations, Dolly-themed merchandise, a sit-down restaurant, a grab-and-go BBQ restaurant, a coffee shop, a trucker's lounge, and a dog park.
The Hooters on 70 Wolf Road in Colonie, the chain's last New York State location, closed after 15 years. A sign on the door confirmed the closure, and New York is now without any Hooters outlets.

All four restaurants at the Valley Post development in Chelsea, Alabama closed abruptly in April 2026, less than six months after opening. Rodney Scott's BBQ was among the closures, tied to a lawsuit and over $12 million in liens against the Pihakis Restaurant Group.

Hero Diner at Valley Post closed abruptly in April 2026, part of a mass closure of all four Valley Post restaurants less than six months after opening. A Shelby County court entered final judgment against Hero Doughnuts-affiliated entities for unpaid obligations.

Little Donkey at Valley Post closed abruptly in April 2026 amid the mass closure of all four Valley Post restaurants. The concept has since returned to its original owner, Joshua Gentry, at its Homewood location.

Luca & Lucy at Valley Post closed abruptly in April 2026 as part of the mass closure of all four Valley Post restaurants. The related Homewood concept was renamed Salice and continues under original chef Rita Bernhardt.

location: William Baker House, corner of Cornmarket and Broad Street, Oxford (UK)
status: expected to open to customers by Saturday, July 4

location: 15900 La Cantera Pkwy, San Antonio, TX
status: will open its first Alamo City restaurant
short_description: Sixty Vines, a Dallas-based wine-on-tap bar and restaurant, will open its first San Antonio location on August 10 at La Cantera Parkway. The concept offers 60 wines on tap alongside wine country-inspired cuisine from the team behind Ida Claire and Whiskey Cake.

California-based Friendly Franchisees Corporation (FFC), which owns 65 Carl's Jr. locations in California, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in April 2026, with 10 locations slated to close and 49 others up for sale. The fate of the remaining stores is uncertain as of late June 2026.

event_date: Not specified (grand opening on a Monday)
short_description: Apne Bazaar, a new South Asian grocery store, is celebrating its grand opening at 6704 Watts Road in Madison with complimentary tea and snacks. The ~6,000 sq ft store carries fresh vegetables, authentic spices, bulk ingredients, and ready-to-cook meals catering to South Asian communities.

location: 4357 NE Chouteau Trafficway, Kansas City, MO
event_date: End of July or beginning of August 2026
status: expected to open later this summer
short_description: The second Kansas City metro World Fresh Market location is expected to open at 4357 NE Chouteau Trafficway after renovations, offering Asian, Middle Eastern, European, Hispanic, and American products. The owner aims to open by end of July or early August 2026.

Five Iron Golf will open its first Connecticut location in August 2026, occupying 8,500 square feet at the SONO 50 building in south Norwalk. The facility will feature 10 Trackman simulators and access to more than 300 virtual golf courses.
Popeyes franchisee Liberty Restaurants Holdings closed its Cicero, NY location on April 30, 2026, as part of ongoing franchise bankruptcies affecting Upstate New York locations.

Liberty Restaurants Holdings closed its Oswego, NY Popeyes location on March 15, 2026, confirmed by the store's former manager. The franchisee operates Popeyes locations in Upstate New York and filed for bankruptcy protection.

location: Florida, Georgia, and other states (specific addresses not specified)
status: might be forced to reject the leases…and permanently close them
short_description: Popeyes franchisee Sailormen Inc., which operated ~130 locations when it filed for bankruptcy in January 2026, was approved to sell 97 restaurants to five buyers for $16.55 million. Approximately 33 locations it could not sell face potential permanent closure via lease rejection.

Five Iron Golf will open its first Connecticut location in August 2026 at the SONO 50 building in south Norwalk, covering 8,500 square feet with 10 Trackman simulators. This is a duplicate of Article 191.

Missouri-based O'Reilly Auto Parts has plans to open two new stores in Connecticut, one in Milford and one in Branford. Connecticut already has more than 200 auto parts store locations among the four largest brands.

location: King Plow Arts Center, West Midtown, Atlanta, GA
short_description: Latin restaurant and rooftop bar Palo Santo closed on June 27, 2026, after four years in West Midtown, as the landlord chose not to renew the lease. The team is planning to open a new restaurant and bar concept, Botánico Cocina & Social Club, in Midtown Atlanta this August.

The team behind Palo Santo will open Botánico Cocina & Social Club, a new restaurant and bar concept, in Midtown Atlanta in August 2026. The menu will feature Latin dishes including sea bass ceviche, chicken tamales, and shrimp cocktail.

Dolly Parton rebranded the pre-existing Tennessean Travel Stop, launching it on June 24 with free samples and a ribbon cutting. The travel stop offers gas, EV charging, a restaurant, coffee shop, Dolly-themed merchandise, and a music stage, with grand opening week events running through July 3.

ROC City Furniture, in business for more than 20 years, is closing its last remaining location and holding a going-out-of-business sale with 40–80% discounts. The owner cited difficult economic conditions and competition from nearby chain furniture stores as reasons for closure.

store_name: Sprouts Farmers Market (Phoenix – 56th St & Deer Valley Dr)
location: 56th Street and Deer Valley Drive, Phoenix, AZ
short_description: Two new Sprouts Farmers Market locations will open in metro Phoenix on July 24, 2026, representing the chain's 49th and 50th Arizona locations. One is at the company's new corporate headquarters at 56th Street and Deer Valley Drive in Phoenix.

store_name: Sprouts Farmers Market (Buckeye – Verrado Way & W Roosevelt St)
location: Verrado Way and West Roosevelt Street, Buckeye, AZ
short_description: The second new Sprouts location opening July 24 in metro Phoenix is located in Buckeye at the intersection of Verrado Way and West Roosevelt Street. Both new Sprouts locations will be the chain's 49th and 50th stores in Arizona.

location: 26 E. Baseline Road, South Phoenix, AZ
short_description: A new Vallarta Supermarkets location is planned for south Phoenix at the intersection of Baseline Road and Central Avenue. It is expected to open in early 2027, according to a news release.

Seafood City, a California-based supermarket specializing in Filipino ingredients and food, will open its first Arizona location at Chandler Fashion Center sometime this summer. No specific opening date was provided.

status: expected opening date in the end of 2026
short_description: A Costco Business Center with a 15-pump gas station is coming to Chandler, Arizona, with an expected opening at the end of 2026. Additionally, a Costco on tribal land near Indian School and Pima roads is planned to open in January 2027.
Whole Foods is set to open a location at the Village at Prasada in Surprise, Arizona; no opening timeline was provided in the article.

location: Intersection of U.S. 17 and Scotts Hill Loop Road, Scotts Hill, NC
short_description: A new Publix grocery store is planned for a commercial development at U.S. 17 and Scotts Hill Loop Road in Scotts Hill. A master development plan has been approved and an application submitted to Pender County to proceed with phase one. The 50,000-square-foot store would include a pharmacy drive-thru and over 350 parking spaces.

location: 24 E. Main St., New Albany, OH
short_description: Harvest Pizzeria announced it will open a new location at 24 E. Main St. in New Albany this fall, replacing the former 24 Main bar and restaurant. The local pizzeria, which first opened in German Village in 2011, is expanding to two new central Ohio locations this year.

location: Between Cancún and Puerto Morelos, Riviera Maya, Mexico
short_description: Hyatt Hotels Corporation and Parks Hospitality Holdings announced plans to open two new all-inclusive resorts in Mexico in the second half of 2026. Park Hyatt Riviera Maya will be located along the Caribbean coast within a private coastal enclave called AMAI, featuring 148 guestrooms and suites. The resort will include seven food and beverage venues offering à la carte dining.

Hyatt Hotels Corporation and Parks Hospitality Holdings announced plans to open two new all-inclusive resorts in Mexico in the second half of 2026. Grand Hyatt Los Cabos is positioned as a distinct offering under the Grand Hyatt brand, integrating all-inclusive services. The projects are part of Hyatt's broader strategy to grow its footprint in the leisure segment.

location: Sunset Beach Park, Downtown Vancouver's West End, Vancouver, BC
short_description: The Vancouver Aquatic Centre will permanently close as planned on June 28 after a BC Supreme Court judge rejected an interim injunction request to stop the closure. The Save Vancouver Aquatic Centre Society had organized rallies and raised nearly $91,000 through crowdfunding to fight the closure in court. The closure enables site preparation and demolition work to begin in Fall 2026 for a new facility.

location: Portfield Retail Park, Chichester, Sussex, UK
short_description: Next is preparing to open a new 17,000 sq.ft store at Portfield Retail Park in Chichester, returning to the city after a five-year absence. The store will feature womenswear, menswear, childrenswear, and home departments, along with a Bath & Body Works concession and a Costa Coffee concession. The ribbon cutting and official opening will take place on Wednesday, July 8 at 10am.

Petit Bois Townhomes held an open house and ribbon cutting, bringing a new townhome community to Rue Palafox in West Biloxi. The development is managed by Heritage Management Group and is positioned between home buying and apartment renting, with units starting at $1,700. The location is described as a few minutes from the beach, nearby shopping centers, schools, and Keesler Air Force Base.

H&M announced it plans to close approximately 170 stores in 2026 as part of its store portfolio optimization strategy. During the first six months of the 2026 financial year, 104 stores closed while 41 stores opened. The article does not specify any individual USA/Canada store closures.

location: Midland Mall food court, Midland, MI
short_description: Winston's Burgers started its soft-opening period on Tuesday, June 23 in the Midland Mall food court, operating with a shortened menu. Owner Winston Wojda expects the soft opening to last about two weeks before moving toward a full menu and a grand opening. The restaurant is located next to Emily Mai's Pho & More, owned by Wojda's wife.

location: 2040 W. Spring Creek Pkwy., Suite 134, Plano, TX 75023
status: not yet ready; opening still several months away
short_description: According to public filings, a new Pakistani restaurant concept called Darbar by Lyari may open at 2040 W. Spring Creek Pkwy., Suite 134 in Plano. A representative from ZIKR Foods LLC confirmed the restaurant is not yet ready to share details and that an opening is still several months away. The project involves a full kitchen build-out, custom millwork, and updated HVAC and plumbing across approximately 4,200 square feet.

status: set to open; construction completion date spring 2027
short_description: dd's Discounts is preparing to open a new retail location in North Austin at the Vista Norte shopping center, according to public filings. Construction on the 18,482-square-foot tenant improvement has a completion date set for spring 2027. The chain, owned by Ross Stores, focuses on brand-name merchandise at steep discounts.

Dom and Frank Morra are taking over 1127 Mainland St. in Yaletown, where Robba da Matti recently closed, to open Rosalia Osteria. The intimate restaurant will seat 33 guests in a 600-square-foot space and serve a pasta-forward menu inspired by Italian Sunday dinners. Rosalia Osteria will run seven days a week for dinner service.

location: 184 South Market St., San Jose, CA
event_date: Soft opening June 25, 2026; grand opening July 24, 2026
short_description: Sakura Market, a Japanese market-style convenience store spearheaded by the team behind Osaka Marketplace, debuted with a soft opening on June 25, 2026 in downtown San Jose. The 5,000 sq.ft store features a matcha cafe, sushi bar, ramen station, beauty section, and a bar for alcoholic beverages expected to open at the grand opening on July 24. The store is inspired by Japan's signature "konbini" convenience stores.

status: under renovation, opening date not yet announced
short_description: Ô Quai des Brasseurs, a Quebec-based brewery and restaurant group, is preparing to open a third location on the shores of Lake Masson in Sainte-Marguerite-du-Lac-Masson. Interior renovations are underway, but the project is still awaiting kitchen equipment installation before moving forward. The restaurant is expected to seat about 250 people and employ around 65 staff once open.

location: 750 W. Shaw St., Howard City, MI
short_description: The community of Howard City celebrated the grand opening of a new McDonald's, the first in Howard City, the seventh in Montcalm County, and the 523rd in Michigan. Owner and operator Mike Rodewald said the goal was to become a positive part of the community by creating local jobs and providing a gathering place for families. Several village and chamber officials attended the event.

A new location of fast-casual street food concept Kazi's Spot is coming soon to the ground floor of the Pinnacle @ 65 building in Bethlehem, in the space formerly occupied by Wiz Kidz restaurant. The Bethlehem location will be the second Kazi's Spot, following the first location that opened in April in Langhorne, Bucks County. Owner Kazi Zoha plans to have six locations by the end of 2026 and 10–15 by end of 2027.

location: Southeast Myra Road, Walla Walla, WA
status: under construction; expected to open sometime in October
short_description: A new WinCo store is under construction along Southeast Myra Road in Walla Walla, with walls up and the roof in place. The project was made possible by the completion of the Myra Road extension, which opened the area for new development. The store is expected to be complete and open sometime in October.

The Sheridan County Chamber of Commerce celebrated the new location of Bought Beautifully with an ambassadors' ribbon cutting on Tuesday, June 23, 2026. Bought Beautifully is a nonprofit market owned by Emily Betzler that connects people to products positively impacting the world. The business is now located at 22 Grinnell Plaza.

status: set to open; no exact opening timeline announced
short_description: ALDI is preparing to open a new location in Phoenix at the former 99 Cents Only Store site, according to liquor license applications and Maricopa County property records. ALDI purchased the property in early June as part of a broader acquisition strategy targeting vacant discount grocery store spaces. No exact opening timeline has been announced.

status: set to open; no exact opening timeline announced
short_description: ALDI is preparing to open a new location in Mesa at a former 99 Cents Only Store site, according to liquor license applications and Maricopa County property records. ALDI purchased the property in early June as part of a broader acquisition strategy. No exact opening timeline has been announced.

Primark opened a new location at Parks Mall in Arlington, Texas, making it one of the retailer's six Texas locations. The article notes the international retailer is now calling Arlington's mall home. No additional details were available in the article text.

Schwebel Baking Company is closing after 120 years in business, and its local bakery outlets will also shut down. One outlet is located at the Olympia Shopping Center in McKeesport, and the company also has operations in South Fayette. Roughly two dozen employees will lose their jobs at each location.

Schwebel Baking Company is closing after 120 years in business, and its local bakery outlets will also shut down. The company has operations in South Fayette in addition to the McKeesport outlet. Company officials say they were not able to find a buyer.

Atlanta officials announced the opening of the country's first container-based, 24/7 AI-powered grocery store at Pittsburgh Yards. Founded by Jamie and Jilea Hemmings, the store offers produce, prepared meals, and personal care products with no clerks or checkout lines needed. The goal is to eliminate food deserts and provide healthy options to the community.

Mandeville Mayor Clay Madden confirmed a Trader Joe's is coming to Pontchartrain Square in Mandeville after a permit was pulled. It would be the first Trader Joe's in Louisiana outside the New Orleans and Baton Rouge markets. The mayor stated construction is progressing and an opening could come by the end of summer, though some timelines remain outside the city's control.

Hometown Paws Dog Daycare & Resort will open for dog daycare and boarding in August 2026, a company representative confirmed. The facility is located next to Tractor Supply Co. on Oklahoma Drive, with crews finishing up construction. Bookings are open for boarding services beginning October 1, with earlier dates to be available as the opening date is finalized.

event_date: Expected within a couple of weeks of publication
short_description: ROC City Furniture at 171 Clay Road in Henrietta is holding a going-out-of-business sale with discounts of 40% to 80%, after more than 20 years in the community. Owner Dan Stewart cited economic conditions and increased competition from chain furniture stores nearby as reasons for closing. The store previously had locations in Greece and Irondequoit, both of which also closed.

location: Multiple Midwest locations (Indiana, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, Ohio, Wisconsin)
short_description: Fast-casual chicken restaurant Birdcall plans to open 85 new locations across the Midwest over the next five years, targeting markets in Indiana, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, Ohio, and Wisconsin. The company currently operates 17 locations in Arizona, Colorado, and Texas. No specific addresses or individual opening dates were provided for any of the planned locations.

Brunch chain First Watch officially opened at 5689 Northwest Highway in Crystal Lake, the first restaurant to open at the Water's Edge development on the former Crystal Court shopping center site. The 3,900-square-foot space seats more than 150 people and features a covered outdoor patio. Customers who dine in during opening week through Friday receive a free coffee with their meal.

Menchie's Frozen Yogurt is also opening this week at the Water's Edge development in Crystal Lake, with a grand opening celebration planned for Thursday featuring free frozen yogurt, balloon animals, and gift bags. No specific street address was provided in the article.

location: Save A A A A view of Lotte Department Store. Lotte Department Store Department store stocks rallied across the board as expectations grew for expanding spending by foreign tourists and a recovery in high-end consumption. Analysts say the earnings improvement in the department store sector could extend beyond the year-end, with rising inbound spending compounded by domestic asset and income effects. Lotte Shopping (023530.KS) was trading at 119,800 won, up 7,500 won or 6.68% from the previous session, as of 2:24 p.m. on the 8th, according to the Korea Exchange. Hyundai Department Store (069960.KS) rose 4.50% to 102,100 won, while Shinsegae (004170.KS) gained 4.41% to 414,000 won. E-Mart (139480.KS) climbed 2.83%, Daegu Department Store (006370.KS) added 1.45% and Hanwha Galleria (452260.KS) edged up 1.05%. Foreign spending is the main driver lifting the sector. Tourism spending averaged 2.1 trillion won a month in the second quarter, up 59.6% from a year earlier, as the exchange rate, per-capita spending by foreign visitors and the number of arrivals all improved. Department stores, which draw a large share of revenue from luxury goods and fashion, are seen as a direct beneficiary channel of the inbound spending boom. Shinsegae is expected to see the gains concentrated at its main store in Myeong-dong. iM Securities estimates net sales to foreign customers at the Shinsegae main store will rise 94.8% this year from a year earlier. The brokerage said the store's ability to capture foreign spending has strengthened as a luxury-focused renovation combined with traffic drawn by its duty-free operations and digital signage. It projects Shinsegae's department store revenue at 3.02 trillion won this year, up 13.0%, with operating profit rising 37.7% to 559.3 billion won.
